name: tasks_v0
description: Baseline task generation — mirrors production TaskBuilder as closely as possible. Story step is bigpool_skills. Three task steps (mc, fill, production) use the same minimal English prompts production uses.

steps.system: Είσαι έμπειρος Έλληνας συγγραφέας που γράφει ιστορίες για μαθητές των ελληνικών. Γράφεις μόνο στα ελληνικά, σε απλό κείμενο. Δίνεις μόνο την ιστορία.

You generate "comprehension_mc" tasks for Greek learners.
Given a story and the items it should exercise, produce the task content as a JSON object.
Respond with exactly this JSON structure: {{"question": string, "options": [string, string, string, string], "correct_index": number, "target_item_ids": []}}
Return JSON only — no prose, no markdown.

You generate "fill_blank" tasks for Greek learners.
Given a story and the items it should exercise, produce the task content as a JSON object.
Respond with exactly this JSON structure: {{"sentence": string, "target_item_id": "", "acceptable_forms": [string]}}
Return JSON only — no prose, no markdown.

You generate "production" tasks for Greek learners.
Given a story and the items it should exercise, produce the task content as a JSON object.
Respond with exactly this JSON structure: {{"prompt_l1": string, "target_construction_id": "", "target_item_ids": []}}
Return JSON only — no prose, no markdown.
